scope: Numeric data source audit for offshore market dashboard JSON files

high_risk.issue: Rig-level dayrates, contract periods, rig specs and weekly deltas have no item-level source fields.
high_risk.recommended_action: Add source/basis/confidence per rig, starting with active dayrate and contract end dates from fleet status reports.

high_risk.issue: Market summary, contractor fleet counts/backlog and many vessel capacity fields are not tied to source URLs.
high_risk.recommended_action: Prioritize contractor backlog/fleet counts and orderbook project capacities; add source_url or confidence fields.

high_risk.issue: Dayrate trend is indicative rather than contract-level verified.
high_risk.recommended_action: Replace curve points with named contract observations or label as indicative in the UI.

medium_risk.issue: Company CAPEX guidance has source labels, but project capacity/reserve/timeline values often rely on nested detail.source text without URLs.
medium_risk.recommended_action: Add source_url for major project pages or filings; mark estimates separately.

medium_risk.issue: Quarterly financial values have source labels but no source URLs; market caps and key rig specs lack item-level sources.
medium_risk.recommended_action: Add filing/news-release URLs per company-period and mark market cap as snapshot/volatile.

medium_risk.issue: Quarterly financial values have source labels but no source URLs; market caps and key asset capacities lack item-level sources.
medium_risk.recommended_action: Add filing/news-release URLs per company-period and source key asset capacities from operator/contractor pages.

lower_risk.issue: News items include URLs and source names.
lower_risk.recommended_action: Keep using primary company releases where available; use trade press only for market color.

source_policy.primary: Company filings, earnings releases, fleet status reports, contractor project pages and operator project pages.
source_policy.secondary: Offshore Energy, Offshore Magazine, World Oil, Rigzone and other trade press for transaction context or market color.
source_policy.volatile_values: Market cap, current dayrate, active fleet count and backlog should carry snapshot dates.
source_policy.estimates: Estimated or directional values must be labelled with basis and confidence, not presented as verified observations.
